canonical_neutral.anchor_measurement: manually observed anatomical support/centre in the native full-body image; not alpha-canvas centering
canonical_neutral.anchor_basis: Midpoint of the two short standing rodent sole contacts under upright trunk; thin side tail and lateral whiskers are excluded from support and body-reference width.
canonical_neutral.vertical_motion_policy: neutral still; scene placement and any trajectory are designed by consumer, no motion acceptance claimed

calibration.method: Exact reuse of adopted neutral geometry; no new drawing.

landmarks.observations: Native homologous head breadth/crown-to-chin and neck/torso-to-support relation manually compared with adopted neutral. One common isotropic reference for this original, shared across its acts; each independent single has its own original calibration. Excluded long ears, ossicone tips and tails follow canonical definition, rather than pose-wise alpha height fitting.

canonical_source.direct_input_role: Adopted neutral identity, style, colour and existing visible anatomy reference; reference only, not a pixel-edit target.

calibration.method: Manual native anatomical comparisons across head/face/torso/feet; one isotropic reference per original sheet, no per-pose bbox fit. Values approximate visual registration, not subpixel metrology.
calibration.selection_basis: Approximate visual anatomical registration on native full-body raster, validated at original maximum use size. No pixel repair or per-pose scale normalization.

frames.anchor_measurement: Assistant native visual anatomical measurement; foot-contact ROI checked in original raster, approximate not subpixel.

frames.vertical_motion_policy: Grounded small gesture; no baked jump. Place recorded anatomical anchor; no automatic per-pose normalization.

scale_policy: One isotropic reference per calibrated source sheet; never fit individual poses.
review_scope: Nine new static pose drawings and exact reused neutral alias, plus seven complete-PNG discrete preview recipes. Pose interpolation or part deformation is not permitted. Scene timing, whole-image transforms and compressed final MP4 quality require production-specific review.
